notes.title: Hunt the Night 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the latest patch for Hunt the Night, packed with exciting changes and improvements. Here's a rundown of what you can expect:

[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Prime Hunt Mode[/b][/h2]

Prime Hunt Mode is now unlocked! Battle against final bosses with new attacks and increased difficulty in a mode where your time will be recorded. Plan and create your build before the fight and prepare for a truly deadly gaming experience. [b]Don't forget to share your times with the community![/b]

Each boss will be unlocked once you defeat them in the normal game mode.

[h2][b]Prime Hunt Collaborations[/b][/h2]

We are pleased to announce our first three collaborations with other indie games, including three completely new bosses from other games adapted to Hunt the Night. In this first pack, you'll find:

- [b]Red Camerlengo[/b] from [b]The Count Lucanor[/b].
- [b]Ice Queen[/b] from [b]Lost Ruins[/b].
- [b]The Watcher[/b] from [b]Bug Fables[/b].

We hope you enjoy these three entirely new battles and take a look at these three games if you haven't already!


[h1][b]Gameplay Enhancements[/b][/h1]

[b]Save System Reimplementation[/b]
Experience a revamped save system for smoother progress tracking.

[b]Backup System[/b]
Introducing a backup feature to ensure your heroic exploits are always secured.

[b]Persistent Shops[/b]
Shops now remember your last selected item, eliminating the hassle of re-browsing.

[b]Text Font Assignments[/b]
Rectified an issue where some in-game texts lacked assigned fonts.

[b]Boss Immunity Fix[/b]
Addressed a bug where certain bosses were erroneously immune to damage effects.

[b]Controller/Keyboard Detection Overhaul[/b]
Entirely redesigned the controller/keyboard detection for enhanced accuracy and performance.

[b]Event Error Resolution[/b]
Fixed the most common 'not found' event errors by implementing a short delay and rechecking.

[b]Spell Casting Corrections[/b]
Enemies no longer attempt to cast spells on non-enemy objects.

[b]Noctilium Window Fix[/b]
Solved the issue of the Noctilium window disappearing after purchasing an item in the shop.

[b]Shift Key Binding[/b]
Added shift key detection for more flexible key binding.

[b]Expanded Key Customization[/b]
Introduced additional actions to the keys binding menu for greater customization.


[h1][b]Main Menu Update[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped the main menu for improved compatibility with larger resolutions.[/b]

[b]Menu Accessibility[/b]
The menu can now be opened even when an 'obtained' message is on the screen.

[b]Completed Hunts Indicator[/b]
Differentiated completed hunts with a distinct color in the hunts menu.

[b]Resolution and Menu Adjustments[/b]
Updated resolution and adjusted the menu for seamless gameplay in very high resolutions.

[b]Shop Selection Bug Fix[/b]
Resolved a bug where the first element of a shop couldn't be selected if the shop closed too quickly.

[b]Default Keyboard Action Bindings Redone[/b]
Reimagined default keyboard action bindings for a more intuitive experience.

[b]Menu Navigation Tweaks[/b]
Squashed small bugs affecting menu navigation.


[h1][b]Boss and Enemy Balancing[/b][/h1]

[b]Adjustments to improve the gameplay of battles against Krevian and Mother.[/b]

[b]Adjusted hitboxes for a more precise combat experience in bosses and standard enemies.[/b]

[h1][b]Hunts[/b][/h1]

[b]Enemy Life Reduction [/b]
Reduced the life of enemies in the first two hunts.

[b]Increased Noctilium Rewards from enemies.[/b]


[h1][b]General Fixes[/b][/h1]

[b]Boss Phase Transition Bug[/b]
Fixed a bug causing boss attacks not to stop upon phase transition, potentially leading to Vesper's untimely demise.

[b]Vesper's Invulnerability Tweaks[/b]
Increased Vesper's invulnerability time upon respawn after falls or sinking. Added a transparency effect for better visibility.

[b]Noctilium Adjustments[/b]
Rebalanced the Noctilium obtained from hunt bosses and certain world enemies.

[b]Visual Polish[/b]
Rectified visual errors in various game zones.

[b]Visual Enhancements[/b]
Added visual improvements to several game zones.

[b]Attack Movement Distance Reduction[/b]
Slightly reduced the distance Vesper covers while attacking.


[h1][b]Optimization
[/b][/h1]
We have worked hard over the past few months to optimize the overall performance of the game, [b]improving the FPS rate[/b] and [b]reducing loading times[/b] across all game zones. We have also reduced the game's size on disk by a few GBs.

notes.title: New free content update coming soon! Prime Hunts and collaborations
notes.notes:
Hello Stalkers!

Hunt the Night is on sale for a limited time and a lot of new free content will arrive soon to the game! Tell your friends and let’s hunt the Night together! 

First, let’s talk a bit about the Prime Hunt system, a great challenge for the greatest Stalkers of Medhram!

What are the ‘Prime Hunts’ and how do they work? 

There will be a new option available in the main menu: [b]Prime Hunts, which includes bosses, records, and times of the best players[/b]. Once selected, you will be able to choose the boss, previously defeated in story mode, that you want to face. These bosses have more health, more damage, and new attack patterns.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gDXQBgL/tablas0.png[/img]

After accepting a Prime Hunt in the Main Menu, Vesper will be inside a Lobby, where the player will receive a limited amount of resources to create their own build to face the boss. The boss combat will be timed so the players get to compete in order to achieve the best time mark with their own build of choice. [b]Each record will be registered and published in the game leaderboards[/b].

[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTHYssQ/2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vh4Xkfd/3.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/1Kc2wtr/444.png[/img]


[h1]Collaborations[/h1]

We are very excited with this update, as Hunt the Night will feature popular bosses from other indie games! Play as Vesper and get ready to hunt creatures that you like from great indie games.

The combat will be challenging and it will adapt both the boss design and music to ‘Hunt the Night’ gameplay style.

The team will be announcing the collabs one after another so you can get sneak peeks of them before release.

Upcoming collaboration will be with [b]Baroque Decay's The Count Lucanor: Red Camerlengo[/b]. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9H72422/lucanor.png[/img]

To do so we have adapted the combat zone, boss and music to Hunt the Night style:  He is a master of fear and can summon dark creatures to hunt Vesper in the abandoned library that is his boss' arena. 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/hCxWwc2/1.png[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KDHGD74/gifpro.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hunt the Night 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, Stalkers!

We have been listening to your invaluable feedback after the release and have worked non-stop to get everything ready. We will be continuously listening to the community, listening to your needs, fixing issues and adding new content!

[i][b][h1]General improvements[/h1][/b][/i]

⦁ Fixed an issue where in certain situations the cursor became invisible after shooting.
⦁ Added windowed mode option.
⦁ Saving time has been improved, reducing processing operations.
⦁ Added a ‘Recovery after falling’ animation that provides invincibility during 1 second and can be canceled by dashing, allowing the player to quickly relocate Vesper.
⦁ Fixed translation issues in several languages.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could prevent Vesper from crossing some doors until reloading the game.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could cause some fences to remain closed until reloading the scene even if the puzzle was solved.
⦁ Added internal FPS limitation.
⦁ Added a ‘Key Binding’ feature to the Main Menu screen.
⦁ Fixed an issue that allowed Vesper to repeat a completed Hunt.
⦁ Fixed Hunt 10.
⦁ Temporal switches can now be restarted.
⦁ Fixed temporal switches sound loop.
⦁ Steam achievements based on stats are achieved directly when collecting the last one.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could prevent the player from attacking or losing abilities like dark powers after the second boss.
⦁ Added new borders to ‘floating orb shooting platforms’, now they should be easier to navigate.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could cause the ‘Hunt Failed’ screen to appear cut in half. 
⦁ Fixed an issue that could cause Wolves to continuously respawn in Aleena’s Rest.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could prevent Umbra appearing in certain rooms inside Bloodisfell Cathedral.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could allow the player to summon Umbra in a pit area in Ashdown Manor.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could cause Vesper to get stuck in some fences in Grimwood.
⦁ Vesper can now pet Asher, the dog in Ravenford City garden.

[b][h1]Overworld improvements[/h1][/b]

⦁ Added a note on the floor in Bloodisfell to provide hints about a secondary quest.
⦁ Increased the ‘item obtained dialog’ screen time for some relevant obtained items.
⦁ Fixed an issue in Grimwood to prevent activating a combat zone when moving too close to certain walls.
⦁ Deep Ravenford: Noctilium drift before ‘Umbra awakens’ cinematic room.
⦁ Deep Ravenford: Removed two Warriors that were too near to one particular door.
⦁ Golden Meadows: Changed the Nightbringer (Big Knight with sword) for 2 Warrior enemies that won’t chase the player right after coming back from the Sanguine Chamber.
⦁ Bowels of the Earth: Combat zone has been balanced.
⦁ Bowels of the Earth: New checkpoints after falling were added. Now the player should appear nearer Vesper’s falling location.
⦁ Bowels of the Earth: Overall enemy balancing.
⦁ Velomere: Overall enemy balancing.
⦁ Daigon Temple: Combat zone has been balanced
⦁ Bloodisfell Dark Power mausoleum: Combat zone has been balanced.
⦁ Modified some enemies' location to prevent them respawning near doors in Open World areas.
⦁ Improved general collisions with walls and edges in the game to prevent Vesper from getting slightly stuck for a few seconds near them.
⦁ Fixed a bug that prevented the 'Moonstone: Hound' chest from appearing when finishing Ravenford if you did not pick it early in the game.
⦁ Fixed an issue that made Vesper disappear from the map in the mirror area in Bloodisfell, also new rooms have been added to this particular wing of Bloodisfell Cathedral.

[b][h1]Bosses balancing[/h1][/b]

[b][h3]Devourer[/h3][/b] 

⦁ General Hitbox balancing.
⦁ Noctilium reward upon death raised to 5000.

[b][h3]Adelram[/h3][/b]

⦁ Boss vitality has been reduced.
⦁ General Hitbox balancing.
⦁ Reduced the combo damage and movement in both boss phases.
⦁ Reduced the damage of Adelram’s projectile attacks.

[b][h3]Beldram[/h3][/b]

⦁ Noctilium reward upon death raised to 12.000.
⦁ Now Vesper cannot fall down through borders during combat.

[b][h3]Aurel[/h3][/b]

⦁ Boss vitality has been slightly reduced.
⦁ Noctilium reward upon death raised to 18.000.

[b][h3]Nuriel, first of the triumvirate[/h3][/b]

⦁ Boss vitality has been slightly reduced.
⦁ Halo attacks damage has been reduced.
⦁ Fixed an issue that could cause Vesper to be killed during Nuriel’s defeat animation.

[b][h3]Krysalis[/h3][/b]

⦁ Stellar Rain: The attack has been modified to leave the combat arena visible and thus avoid necessary falls of the player due to not seeing the edges.

[b][h3]Mother[/h3][/b]

⦁ Boss vitality has been slightly reduced.
⦁ Mother’s summoned eyes' vitality has been slightly reduced.

[b][h1]Hunts improvements[/h1][/b]

⦁ Hunts Noctilium reward increased: Now completing hunts will vastly improve the player’s economy along with Vesper’s vitality. 
⦁ Hunt 10, Full Moon: Combat music has been changed. Fixed an issue that could cause Vesper to be thrown out of the combat room. 
⦁ Hunt 9, Khorrax: Changed the enemy sprite to make it easier to identify. Health has been reduced. Limited the amount of enemies that can be in the room at the same time. Increased enemy summon skill cooldown.  

[b][h1]Enemies balancing[/h1][/b]

[b]Darkspawn [/b](small eyeless enemies):

⦁	General hitbox balancing.
⦁	Increased attack warning animation.
⦁	Reduced movement speed.

[b]Mindhunter [/b](purple orb projectile enemy):

⦁	Projectile damage has been reduced.
⦁	Projectile speed has been reduced.

[b]Channeler[/b] (Blind praising creature):

⦁	Vitality has been reduced.
⦁	Reduced the time that the chasing orb chases the player.
⦁	Reduced chasing speed from the chasing orb.
⦁	Reduced orb regular damage.
⦁	Reduced skull attack regular damage.

[b]Warrior[/b] (Regular enemy with full armor):

⦁	Attack hitbox has been balanced.

[b]Rotten [/b](Zombie like creature with a sting):

⦁	Attack hitbox has been balanced.

[b]Stinger [/b](Crawling enemy with a sting):

⦁	Attack hitbox has been balanced.
⦁	Vitality has been reduced.

[b]Drovai[/b] (Flying hemokinesis user enemy):

⦁	Vitality has been reduced.

[b]Infector[/b] (Small dark creature throwing 3 venomous projectiles):

⦁	Projectile speed has been reduced.

notes.title: UPDATE: Full Patch Notes Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Stalkers,

Thanks so much for your feedback and patience! We are currently translating the patch notes into other languages. We will post the full patch details soon, but didn’t want the improvements for the game to be delayed. So, to whet your appetite, we have a short list of what you will find in the patch:

- Disappearing mouse cursor fixed.
- Steam cloud saves added.
- Saving time improved.
- Added internal FPS limit to prevent extremely high frame rates.
- Fixed an issue that caused player control issues after the second boss.
- Translation issues fixed.
- Issue with doors that couldn't be entered and with gates that would remain closed fixed.
- Boss hit boxes adjusted.
- Boss balancing adjustments made, especially to the first and second bosses
- And a lot more...

- Moonlight Games

notes.title: RELEASE DATE WINDOW + SEVERAL OTHER THINGS
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays Stalkers.

The year of the Night has come.

Hunt the Night will arrive on PC in March.

And a few months later on consoles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40713724/854c948e7df16ecd289579319340f28dca6817b9.png[/img]

[h1]FEEDBACK ANALYSIS AND IMPLEMENTATION[/h1]
During the last demo we summarized and analyzed all the feedback received and tried to implement the most demanded features. As we always say, our priority is to deliver the best possible version of HTN, and that could only be possible with your feedback.

 This has lead to several improvements and HtN gameplay has been greatly improved regarding Vesper control and combat imput. Here's a summary of our progress after the last demo trial on Steam:

-New controls for keyboard/mouse based on feedback, now you can play using the mouse to choose where you want to hit.

-Improved the combat system. Now all of the combos of each weapon can be 'skipped' with a dash from a specific frame.

-Improved the operation of the combos in general according to the improvement of the combat system.

-Completely redesigned the options menu and implementation of new options based on feedback: Resolution, hide warning of low health and brightness, among other HUD improvements.

-We have unified the entire graphical interface of the game according to the redesign of the options menu.

-Improved the main menu to be more consistent with the game art.

-Complete new implementation of the save system: Implementation of save slots. There are up to five save slots operational.

-Fixed several inventory bugs.

-Implementation of recolors for every weapon and combat suit.

[h1]NEW GAME MODES: NEW GAME +AND NIGHTMARE MODE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40713724/d76661a5988493c454232f32885e63fa1992424a.png[/img]
New game + will allow players to complete the game in a higher difficulty from the very beginning. Both enemies and bosses will have extra health and cause more damage. This mode will be unlocked after completing the regular game mode.

Nightmare mode will be unlocked after the first playthrough too, but the challenge will be much higher. Enemies and bosses will insta kill Vesper when damaging her and will also have extra health, like in the New game + mode.

[h1]NEW GAME MODE: PRIME HUNTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40713724/96f74dcbe0c8547328e1754025035844d6616172.png[/img]
One of the most common feedback that we have was that the Prime hunt mode was really fun. The prime hunt mode was created as a test to check if there was interest on it, that's why was available during the demo. 

As a reminder, the Prime hunt mode is a special feature that allows you to hunt already beated bosses during the game, but they will present a more demanding challenge. You will have a limit amount of resources to create your build (by buying equipment and dark powers from the vendor) or the build you consider best to hunt that particular boss. The hunt will be timed and your best time for each boss will be desplayed in the Prime Hunt menu.

After the Steam demo feedback we decided to fully implement it, and it will be present in the game.

Implementations and game modes took extra time but we belive that, in the end, they will pay off and improve the game, making it more complex, replayable and, in general, a better game.

This has been our focus during the whole development, to create a game that you could be proud of had backed from the very beginning. Thanks to you now is bigger and better. World, gameplay, game modes, pixel art, languages, combat suits and weapons, bosses, enemies and several other things have move in the right direction thanks to your feedback and support.

notes.title: HUNT THE NIGHT DEMO V1.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
- Added a new screen suggesting the use of Controller and headphones.

- Fixed text display duration during the Game intro, as they were displayed too fast.

- General gameplay balancing regarding some rooms and enemies.

- Modified the default Mouse+Keyboard controls to make them more intuitive.

- Improved the aim system when using Mouse+keyboard controls.

- Modified the sprite and effects of the Dark Barriers that appear during several parts of the game, including combat zones and bosses.

- The animation and damage of both Hunting Spear and Lacerators have been changed. They were underperforming compared Sword and Greatsword and the hitbox wasn't working as intended. Animations were altered in order to fit the new gameplay style better.

- Added a new interaction system. Now a '!' symbol will be displayed when the player is near interactive objects. Furthermore, we improved the collision and interacion zones to make it easier to interact when near them.

- Added extra information regarding 'Crow Feathers'. We specified that they are important to solve puzzles too, as we believe this use wasn't clear enough in the previous version. Also, now key words to solve particular puzzles will be displayed in a different color.

- Changed the 'Crow Shinre' (Save points) sprite. Sometimes it wasn't visible enough and it is  very important regarding gameplay, as it saves your progress and refill your health, bullets and Crimson Roses. Now it will be a predominant asset when placed in an area.

- Some of the 'Devourer' and 'Prime Devourer' hitboxes have been modified and adjusted to better suit the animation.

- Modified several 'Prime Devourer' animations to make them more visible.

- Modified the 'Marauders' (Invisible enemies) location to avoid players losing focus just before starting the Statue's puzzle.

- Added and modified several in game sounds.

- Fixed an issue regarding HUD player warning when heal was low.

- The 'Prime Hunt' lobby display has been changed. Now the chest with the Noctilium is placed near to the vendor, so it is easy to get the currency, buy the items, equip them and fight the boss.
